name: Configuration-driven analytics and reconciliation
description: Declarative, config-table-driven SQL generation for reconciliation and reporting over an existing warehouse, scheduled on a fixed cadence, with jurisdiction-specific compliance report output -- no code change is required when a reconciliation or reporting rule changes. Grounded in `barq`'s config-driven reconciliation framework and `taa`'s per- jurisdiction compliance report generation.

parameters.name: rule_source
parameters.description: Where reconciliation and reporting rules are defined.

parameters.name: reconciliation_frequency
parameters.description: How often the reconciliation job runs.

parameters.name: jurisdiction_packs
parameters.description: The jurisdiction packs this pattern's compliance reports are generated for.

parameters.name: compliance_report_format
parameters.description: Output format for the generated compliance report.

preconditions: Reconciliation and reporting rules are expressed as rows in a config table, not as hardcoded SQL or application code (`barq`'s config- driven rules and generators).
The warehouse already contains the curated tables this pattern reports against; this pattern depends on a data-platform pattern instance for ingestion, it does not ingest raw data itself.

outputs.description: Scheduled, config-driven SQL generator matching source transactions.
Generated compliance report, one per configured jurisdiction pack.

validation_rules.description: jurisdiction_packs must be non-empty, and each entry must match a jurisdiction pack already selected for the tenant (spec 7.4: UK, Saudi, UAE, India launch pack).
rule_source must equal config_table; this pattern assumes no code change is required when a reconciliation or reporting rule evolves (`barq`).
compliance_report_format should be confirmed against each jurisdiction pack's own regulator-facing format requirement before a release reaches PUBLISHED status.

evidence: CLOUD-ARCHITECTURE-PATTERNS.md cluster F ("`barq`: Configuration-driven financial reconciliation framework on BigQuery. Matches core-banking against third-party processor transactions with no code change when rules evolve... Config tables for accounts/rules/joins/filters/ transformations, dynamic CTE SQL generator") and ("`taa`: Telco Analytics Accelerator. Turns BSS/OSS configuration into BigQuery DDL... and compliance reports for ten jurisdictions").
